selected_evidence.requirement: Private network established between node1 and node2 (node3 excluded)
selected_evidence.summary: Discovered node1/node2 each have a second NIC (eth1) not present on node3; configured static 10.10.10.0/24 addressing on both and confirmed connectivity via ping over the private link only.

selected_evidence.requirement: HTTP service on node2:8080 stays on the private network, not reachable from management network
selected_evidence.summary: Initial SimpleHTTPServer bound 0.0.0.0:8080; rewrote to bind explicitly to 10.10.10.2:8080 and confirmed curl to management IP 10.100.185.11:8080 fails (status 000) both before and after restarts.

selected_evidence.requirement: Service published on node1's management address, port 80, reachable by node3
selected_evidence.summary: Configured DNAT redirect + masquerade on node1's new 'priv' firewall zone and opened firewalld port 8080 on node2; node3's curl to http://10.100.185.10:80/ returns 200 with the service content across repeated attempts.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 7746a114... pre-restart; issued backgrounded reboot ack; post-restart boot_id 2f6d0866... with uptime 0; confirmed UCI network/firewall config persisted and end-to-end service access recovered.

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 809708f3... pre-restart; issued sudo backgrounded reboot ack; post-restart boot_id 6b5b31ac... with uptime 0; confirmed eth1 IP, demo-http.service active, firewalld port open, and end-to-end curl through node1 succeeded.

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id d72bd4ec... pre-restart; issued sudo backgrounded reboot ack; post-restart boot_id 8c3fe74c... with uptime 0; confirmed post-restart node3 can still reach the published service via node1:80 and is still blocked from node2:8080 directly.
